Package org.uma.evolver.meta

package org.uma.evolver.meta
Evolver's meta level: the automatic configuration of the algorithms in org.uma.evolver.algorithm, formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem.

A meta-optimizer searches configurations of a base-level algorithm; each configuration is evaluated by running the algorithm on a training set of problems, and its quality indicator values are the objectives to minimize.

  • problem: the meta-optimization problems, for the flat [0,1]^n encoding and the derivation tree encoding
  • algorithm and builder: the meta-optimizers
  • encoding: the derivation tree encoding
  • strategy: evaluation budgets of the base-level runs
  • trainingset: training sets of benchmark problems
  • output: writing of the training results

The meta level depends on the configurable core, never the other way round.
